note: Shape-only statistical base. The load curve below was fitted from a real recorded transit corpus and is the ONLY quantity carried over; no place, route, stop, identifier or crowding level from that corpus appears anywhere in this project. All Delhi scale parameters (capacity, peaks, demand) are Delhi assumptions.
load_profile_meaning: mean normalized load at each tenth of a run, origin to terminus

capacity.status: ASSUMPTION - Urban Bus Specification figures, primary MoHUA document unconfirmed

hourly_demand_status: ASSUMPTION - broad 08-10 and 17-20 peaks over a high daytime plateau
weekly_demand_status: ASSUMPTION - Saturday is a working day for many Indian commuters
